title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Named Myrtle Avenue destinations along Pratt’s north edge and nearby Clinton Hill commercial corridor.

cards.title: Bergen Bagels: on-premises baking
cards.subtitle: Myrtle Avenue corridor — 536 Myrtle Ave, between Grand and Steuben
cards.notes: Walk Myrtle Avenue to the Grand–Steuben block and use the posted address to find bagels, bread, muffins, and cream cheese prepared on-site.
cards.short_summary: A Myrtle Avenue bakery with on-premises preparation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Myrtle Avenue Brooklyn Partnership lists Bergen Bagels at 536 Myrtle Avenue and says its baking and preparation are done on-premises.
cards.source_title: Bergen Bagels — Myrtle Avenue Brooklyn Partnership
cards.access_notes: Business storefront; confirm hours directly before visiting.

cards.evidence_claim: The 2025 Myrtle Avenue Neighborhood Guide lists Blick Art Supplies at 536 Myrtle Avenue in its Art & Framing section.
